verdict.rationale: PostHog documents its own official SDKs, instrumented client-side and server-side across 26+ frameworks and languages. The AI wizard wires them into a codebase from one command, and a hands-on community report confirms a straightforward Swift iOS SDK integration. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK reference documentation or a per-language SDK list in the evidence, and maturity details for SDKs beyond the beta 0.x @posthog/mcp SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Writes code and instruments the PostHog SDKs client-side and server-side
Custom events you capture from any SDK, each with the properties you attach to them.
The AI wizard can create a brand-new PostHog account, spin up a project, and wire up the SDK in your codebase, all from one command
Pretty straightforward to integrate with a Swift iOS app too!
